shiftStats: Per-shift minimum morale and average change
title: Schedule & morale simulation
editHint: Click a slot to edit its operator. Play or scrub the timeline to view morale on this board.
simulationHint: Click an operator to view their morale curve. Switch to Edit schedule to change assignments.
subtitle: Start everyone at full morale and explore consecutive schedule cycles.
storageWarning: Settings could not be saved; they remain available for this visit.
needCycles: Select at least 2 cycles to check stability
stable: Morale at the last two cycle ends is stable
notStable: Morale at cycle ends is still changing
noRed: No exhausted operators within this simulation
summary: Start {start} · End {end} · Min {min} ({minTime}) · Max {max} ({maxTime}) · Exhausted for {red} h
ledger: Consumption and recovery details (overridden contributions are struck through)
entry_target_missing: The swap target is not in the base
dorm_unavailable: The selected dorm is missing or full
target_not_higher: Target morale is not higher than the incoming operator
assumptions: Initial morale is fixed at 24; dorm ambience uses the level maximum. Simulated occupancy does not change the schedule or exports.
missingTraining: Training data is missing for {names}; E2 level 30 is assumed.
settingsDescription: Uses the current schedule, base and roster. Changes recalculate the simulation and return to the start.
simulationOnly: The global switch and named targets are shared with the schedule. Per-shift switches, target modes and waiting rules are simulation-only and are not exported to MAA/Mower.
idleRules: Admit idle operators below full morale in order: use vacant beds first, then the model’s replacement rules. A named target is a fallback after automatic rules, and must have higher morale.
noIdle: No idle operators currently need a dorm. Increase the cycle count to inspect later shifts.
